title: P vs NP: Complexity Classes, Reductions, and NP-Completeness
description: Formalizes the P vs NP problem. Defines complexity classes P and NP, polynomial-time reductions, NP-completeness, and states the central conjecture. Proves P ⊆ NP, states Cook-Levin theorem (SAT is NP-complete), and derives structural consequences. 7 axioms using an abstract computation model.

meta.author: Lean Genius Research
meta.assumptions: 7 axioms for Cook-Levin and NP-completeness transfer.

overview.historicalContext: The P vs NP problem is one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems, asking whether every problem whose solution can be quickly verified can also be quickly solved.
overview.problemStatement: Formalize complexity classes P and NP and state the central P≠NP conjecture.
overview.proofStrategy: Abstract Turing machine model (programs as natural numbers), polynomial arithmetic bounds proved.
keyInsights: **P_subset_NP**: Every problem solvable in polynomial time is also verifiable in polynomial time
**Assumptions**: 7 axioms for Cook-Levin and NP-completeness transfer.
